summary.intent: Run cargo-mutants mutation testing on the Rust diff for work package S (git boundary) in the callisto repo, close any surviving mutants, and push the branch.
summary.outcome: After fixing the diff pathspec, mutation testing found 6 missed mutants in `files_at`/`files_named`. A real-git model test with an awkward file name was added, and a rerun showed zero missed (22 caught, 5 unviable). The test was committed and the branch pushed.

repo: `mutants.out.old/` is tracked on main (committed earlier by someone else), so cleaning cargo-mutants output with `rm` shows up as deletions in git status and must be restored.
`files_at` and `files_named` in the model crate were only exercised by CLI tests outside the mutated crates, so mutants in them survived until a model-level test was added.
The work lives in the worktree `.claude/worktrees/wp-s-git-boundary`, with VCS tests in `crates/callisto-model/src/vcs/tests.rs`.
The mutation diff pathspec must be `crates` (not the earlier value) or the diff comes out empty.

code.finding: Added a real-git listing test using an awkward file name; it kills the mutants in `files_at`/`files_named` and also pins the `-z` (NUL-separated output) fix.

workflow: Check that the diff fed to cargo-mutants is non-empty; an empty diff from a wrong pathspec silently yields a meaningless run.
Cover mutated functions with tests inside the mutated crate, since tests in other crates (e.g. CLI) are not counted.
Check git status after cleaning tool output directories, as some of them are tracked.
Push with an explicit refspec to avoid ambiguity.
